text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Fuji Kiseki has a number
of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember that promise we made
before?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We made a promise to go on a hot
spring
vacation once we had the time,
remember?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She whips out a familiar-looking hot
spring
vacation coupon out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now that things have calmed down, why
don't we
go? I promise it'll be a vacation
unlike any you've
ever had.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We decide a date for our trip right away,
and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of our hot spring vacation is
here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I run to our meeting spot, hoping I'm not
too late.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh! Good morning, Trainer! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You're fine. I've already
contacted the
inn, so we can take it
easy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
By the way, have you eaten breakfast
yet? I
ordered some takeout just in case.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We can eat it together on the train, if
you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki acts as my guide, and we
make it to
the inn safely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey! How was your bath? Nice and
relaxing, I
hope?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's great. The water was so nice, it
warmed me
right to my core.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
While we're at it, here. Have some
delicious
spring water. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki continues to be the perfect
guide and
host as we make our way
through the inn.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There's a beautiful field of flowers over
there and
still time before dinner, so
why don't we go and
take a look?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You look like you really like the
food.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You can have my share too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, she has me by the
hand, leading
me down a rural path
through the rice fields.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's getting dark, so watch your step!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've just been going with the
flow and
letting her take care of me the
entire time.
choice_data_list: (Is Fuji getting proper rest, I wo...
(I wonder if Fuji is getting prope...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This trip is meant to be relaxing for both
of us—I
can't let her exhaust herself like
this!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? Are you tired?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I shouldn't have dragged you out
on a walk
without warning. Let's head
back.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What is it, then?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her how I want her to let her own
hair down
and relax instead of worrying
over me constantly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that all? Thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I'm doing this because I
love making
you smile more than
anything.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Getting to see you smile all day long has
been so
nourishing for my both my heart
and body.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But... Well... If you'd really like me to
relax more,
then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She snaps her fingers smartly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Peeeew!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A huge firework shoots into the air and
explodes
above us!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'd like you to enjoy this trip with every
fiber of
your being.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Surprised? I didn't set this up, to
be
honest. There just happens to be a
fireworks show
today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is supposed to be a good secret
spot to view
it from.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks launch one after the next and
bloom
bright and sparkling in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considering how perfect our timing was,
she must
have invited me on this walk
just for the fireworks
show.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I think back on our day together, I
realize
Fuji Kiseki must've readied
everything in advance.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you're having fun! There are
some
benches we can sit on over ther—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's wrong? You're staring at me
so
intensely.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
choice_data_list: Thank you for the wonderful memories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's obvious how much heart and effort
she put into today's preparations, from
breakfast to the
flower field to the
fireworks show.
choice_data_list: I'm so happy you prepared so much ...
I'm really glad you prepared so mu...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A lovely red tinges Fuji Kiseki's cheeks
as I speak.
choice_data_list: I'm just so happy right now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
O-oh. Well... I'm happy to hear that. The
thing
is...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to make today special. I
hope I
didn't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew... That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to thank you too for gracing me
with your
wonderful smile.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Here's to many more days of smiling
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Fuji Kiseki and I have formed
an
irreplaceable bond during this time
together.
